title: NodeState
description: A node's current state, as its graph events project it (docs/design/m0/13 "Evaluation"). waiting: some inputs have no applicable result yet (a structural wait, no hold). held: an external wait, with its hold (plan 15 L4); this includes a could_not_run that retries on its signal (13 [G2]). claimed: its inputs are fixed and its key computed, in one writer transaction (13 [G10]). completed: a result is selected. superseded: a replacement node took over (13). The transitions are internal/graph's.

waiting_on.description: The names of the inputs still missing; non-empty exactly while waiting.

key.description: Set from the claim on, never while waiting. A held node has one only if it was claimed before the hold.

result.description: The selected result; set exactly when completed.

superseded_by.description: The replacement node; set exactly when superseded.
